description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing NotificationRequest entities in a SQL database, including custom queries and update/delete operations related to notification requests.

classes.name: NotificationRequestRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for NotificationRequestEntity with custom query methods for notification request management.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndOriginatorEntityType
methods.description: Finds notification requests by tenant ID and originator entity type with pagination.

methods.name: findInfosByTenantIdAndOriginatorEntityTypeAndSearchText
methods.description: Retrieves notification request info entities filtered by tenant ID, originator type, and optional search text.

methods.name: findInfoById
methods.description: Finds notification request info by request ID.

methods.name: findAllIdsByStatusAndRuleId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of notification requests filtered by status and rule ID.

methods.name: findAllByRuleIdAndOriginatorEntityIdAndOriginatorEntityTypeAndStatus
methods.description: Finds all notification requests matching specific rule ID, originator entity ID, type, and status.

methods.name: findAllByStatus
methods.description: Finds all notification requests with a specific status, with pagination.

methods.name: updateStatusAndStatsById
methods.description: Updates the status and stats of a notification request by ID.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndStatusAndTargetsContaining
methods.description: Checks if a notification request exists for a tenant with a specific status and target.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndStatusAndTemplateId
methods.description: Checks if a notification request exists for a tenant with a specific status and template ID.

methods.name: deleteByTenantIdAndCreatedTimeBeforeBatch
methods.description: Deletes notification requests in batch for a tenant created before a certain timestamp.

methods.name: deleteByTenantId
methods.description: Deletes all notification requests for a specific tenant.
